dataset_source: https://www.10xgenomics.com/datasets (Janesick et al., Nat. Commun. 2023; GEO GSE243275)
ingest_scope: full whole-slide ingest (cells + nuclei polygons, transcript points, DAPI morphology raster pyramid) emitting MVT + Parquet

gene_panel_breakdown.note: 541 codewords = 313 expression features (280 predesigned + 33 custom) + 228 negative-control / blank codewords; the expression vector preserves all 541 entries to maintain index alignment with cell_feature_matrix.

expression_storage_format: JSON-encoded list under tags["expression"]; consumers parse with json.loads (tags column schema is map<utf8, utf8>)

ontology_attachment.note: The Xenium Rep1 dataset has no native cell-type ontology. The pipeline ingests 10x graph-clustering assignments (analysis/clustering/gene_expression_graphclust/clusters.csv) and surfaces them as cluster_id; mapping clusters to Cell Ontology URIs requires manual marker-gene curation, out of scope for this validation.

converter: mudm-tools v0.6.3 full-slide Xenium converter (the ingest that produced the companion data catalogue dataset xenium-breast-full)
provenance: Counts are taken from the v0.6.3 full-slide ingest that produced the companion data catalogue (mudm-data: tiles2d/xenium-breast-full); see logs/xenium-breast-full_convert.log on the analysis host (oden). These are the numbers used in the Methods and the Supplementary catalogue.

supersedes.note: An earlier v0.5.0 ingest spike (2026-04-29) reported rep1_total_cells = 167780 from a 200-cell smoke test plus a cells.parquet row count. The v0.6.3 full-slide ingest counts 169088 cell features; the manuscript uses the v0.6.3 numbers. This file replaces that spike to keep the paper's cell count traceable to a deposited artifact.

hardware.description: oden: 80-core Linux host + 2x NVIDIA RTX A4500

notes: Validated end-to-end full-slide ingest of Xenium FFPE Human Breast Cancer Rep1: 169,088 cell polygons, 169,083 nucleus polygons, 42,638,083 transcript points, and a DAPI morphology raster pyramid (0.2125 um/px), emitting standard MVT for 2D viewers and Parquet for ML. 541-codeword panel; CRS physical/micrometers.
